name: Selection AI Editor
title: Selection AI Editor
description: Contextual floating AI toolbar and formatting bar that anchors to text selections, with simulated multi-stage reasoning, word-by-word answer reveal and inline editing.
summary: A selection editor built on the CSS Custom Highlight API, with a spring-positioned floating toolbar, formatting controls that stay open between toggles, an animated reasoning orb, staggered source citations, and a word-by-word reveal of the provided answer that can replace the selection.
highlights: Precise cursor-targeted anchoring that calculates exact pointerup release coordinates rather than ambiguous multi-line centers
Formatting persistence allowing sequential Bold, Italic, Underline and Strikethrough toggles without losing the toolbar
Native CSS Highlight API (::highlight(editor-ask)) integration that keeps text selections visibly active during input focus
Multi-stage thinking drawer that runs on timers: understanding the context, gathering sources, then revealing the answer
Pure in-place focus dissolution on dismiss (opacity: 0, blur: 6px) eliminating jarring position snaps or scale jumps
Dynamic bi-directional indicator arrow with auto-clamping boundary detection and offset calculation
Replace selection, Append to document, or Copy to clipboard once the answer finishes
anatomy: <Editor> (Outer relative wrapper with selectionchange listener and highlight provider)
<ContentEditable> (Accessible semantic text surface with title and body paragraph)
<FloatingToolbar> (Absolute-positioned pill with spring entrance and in-place dissolve exit)
<IndicatorArrow> (Bi-directional directional pointer aligning directly with cursor release coordinates)
<FormattingGroup> (Bold, Italic, Underline and Strikethrough with active state, plus a Code button)
<AskAIButton> (Ask AI button with a static micro orb and gradient border)
<PromptComposer> (Inline query input field with autofocus, enter-to-submit, and escape-to-collapse)
<ReasoningOrb> (Animated SVG orb switching from S3 (understanding) to S2 (gathering sources))
<TextShimmer> (Radiant linear gradient sweep passing over stage status indicators)
<SourceCitations> (Staggered favicon badges loaded dynamically from external domains)
<StreamingText> (Word-by-word reveal of the answer prop with a blinking cursor)
<CompletionActions> (Replace selection, append to document, and copy-to-clipboard buttons)

physics.description: Harmonic oscillator spring dynamics (stiffness 440, damping 28, mass 0.7) for toolbar positioning, combined with pure cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) in-place blur dissipation on dismiss.

accessibility.aria: Accessible contentEditable document with aria-label and role="textbox", a role="toolbar" with aria-label="Selection", and labelled buttons. The text surface has a focus-visible style.

keyboard.description: In the Ask AI input, submits the question.
In the Ask AI input, closes the toolbar and exits Ask AI mode.
Moves between toolbar buttons and the prompt input.
Browser-native bold in the editable text (not handled by the component).
Browser-native italic in the editable text (not handled by the component).

accessibility.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion, the toolbar layout resize and the stage panel height change instantly. Other entrance, exit and hover animations still run.

props.description: Callback triggered when the user submits an AI query from the toolbar.

recommended: Notion or Lex-style collaborative and AI-assisted text editors
Inline AI copilots for blog writing, documentation, and markdown composers
Interactive document viewers where readers highlight text to ask context questions
bestPractices: Avoid nesting inside elements with overflow: hidden that might clip the floating toolbar
Provide meaningful fallback styling for browsers that do not yet support the CSS Custom Highlight API
Ensure contentEditable text has high color contrast in both light and dark themes
